appearances.identity: Clothing-only homage to the blue-and-white SMG4 outfit seen in the official model on the LEFT of the third reference. Royal-blue rounded cap with small white badge bearing one simple blue film-camera pictogram; cap behind and above both huge uncovered frog eyes. appearances.identity: True body redesign into an original theatrical rubber-hose cartoon amphibian for the SMG4 world. Ribbit's unmistakable lime frog face, two huge white wedge-pupil eyes, round pink cheeks and broad curved smile. The oval cream belly incorporates a pink bow-shaped patch. A small blue stage cap sits behind eyes, a navy waist band with two gold fasteners echoes show clothing. Visible physical remodeling: enlarged hands/feet, curved bendy limbs and broad belly, coherent connected anatomy, no robot joints, no detached gloves, no motion smear, no stretch attack or spring. Use second-reference playful geometric treatment but avoid rabbit ears, red overalls, joystick antennae or purple body.
